title: ScriptEditor.reload_open_files() is unreliable
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproduced in: v4.7.rc1.official [a4f5e8cdd], v4.7.beta5.official [bbd3f43b5]

### System information

Godot v4.7.rc1 - Fedora Linux 44 (Workstation Edition) on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - Mesa Intel(R) Iris(R) Xe Graphics (RPL-U) - 13th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-1355U (12 threads) - 15.31 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

Calling `EditorInterface.get_script_editor().reload_open_files()` immediately after changing the currently visible script in the Script Editor with an external program sometimes reloads the script in the view and sometimes it doesn't. For me this is most unreliable when trying to do this multiple times a second or very soon after saving the script in the Script Editor.

Ideally this would work reliably, or at least fail more gracefully. Right now when it fails it shows a different script in the Script Editor than is saved on disk. It shows the script before its modification by an external program.

### Steps to reproduce

The MRP lets you easily test modifying a script and immediately reloading it. (It helps to have `text_editor/behavior/files/auto_reload_scripts_on_external_change = true` in the Editor Settings for testing purposes, but it makes no apparent difference to the issue.)

1. Open `main.tscn` to show it in the Scene dock.
2. Open `changing.gd` to show it in the Script Editor.
3. Click on the `Changer` node in the Scene dock. This shows a tool button in the inspector titled `Change and Reload`.
4. Click on the `Change and Reload` button. This runs a python script to append a commented line to `changing.gd`, then calls `EditorInterface.get_script_editor().reload_open_files()`. (Python must be installed.)

For me, spamming the button makes the Script Editor update the script erratically, sometimes not adding a new comment line and sometimes adding multiple new comment lines. (Viewed externally, it looks like pressing the button always changes the script, but doesn't reload it in the Script Editor every time.)

Besides spamming the button, also try saving the script in the editor and then pressing the button immediately after. This is also unreliable for me.

However, it works reliably for me when I wait 2 seconds between button presses and do nothing in between.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[script-editor-reload-files-mrp.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28780768/script-editor-reload-files-mrp.zip)
